metadata.title: Minimal Surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ with Three Planar Ends II: Symmetry and Nonexistence
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study complete minimal surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ with three embedded planar ends parallel to those of the union of the Lagrangian catenoid and the plane containing its waist circle. We prove that no such complete embedded minimal surface of genus $g\geq 2$ with finite total curvature admits at least $4(g+1)$ symmetries. This contrasts sharply with the genus-one case, where highly symmetric examples do exist and are uniquely determined up to scaling and rigid motion.
metadata.comment: 43 pages. This paper is Part II of a manuscript originally posted as arXiv: 2504.02282 , which has since been divided into two parts

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究 R⁴ 中具有三条指定方向的嵌入平面端、有限总曲率极小曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明属数 g≥2 的此类完备嵌入曲面不可能具有至少 4(g+1) 个对称，区别于高对称且具有唯一性结果的属一情形。
analysis.limitations: 端必须平行于指定 Lagrangian catenoid 加腰平面模型；这是对称数量限制，不是排除所有高属三端极小曲面。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 极小曲面存在性与高对称约束的细致区分。
